answer_1.quote: In this paper we investigate the incorporation of semantic scene graphs and syntactic constituency structure information for cross-lingual image captioning... The framework includes two phrases, semantic structure-guided image-to-pivot captioning and syntactic structure-guided pivot-to-target translating.
answer_1.outputs: Target-language captions generated for images (e.g., Chinese captions for English images and English captions for Chinese images)

answer_2.quote: Following baselines, we report the BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE and CIDEr scores for model evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We further try to quantify the improvements of the generated captions via human evaluation... We ask ten native Chinese speakers to score the results. ... We design a Likert 10-scale to measure the relevancy, diversification, and fluency of the generated target-side captions.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters scored generated captions on a Likert 10-point scale for relevancy, diversification, fluency, and also evaluated errors in wording, word order, and syntax correctness.
